The determinant is exactly $5$. NumPy printed $5.000000000000001$ because it uses floating-point arithmetic, which can introduce tiny rounding errors. For a $2 \times 2$ matrix $\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$, the determinant is $ad - bc$, so here it is $2 \cdot 3 - 1 \cdot 1 = 5$.

The integral is exactly $9$, since $\int_0^3 x^2\,dx = \left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^3 = \frac{27}{3} = 9$.
